reuse.why: Puts the daily-skip logic into shared/schedules.ts helpers used by getNextDate and getUpcomingDates, and makes the budget template rely on getNextDate instead of its own weekend adjustment; getUpcomingDates still keeps its own move-weekend mapping instead of a shared resolver.

duplication.why: Removes the template's two copies of the weekend adjustment, but the 'daily skip vs move' dispatch is written twice, in getNextDate and in getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts with the other recurrence helpers and frequency is carried on the rschedule data built in rule-utils; the shared module now also takes a type from #server/util/rschedule.

scope.why: The template loop rewrite is needed to route it through getNextDate and stays on topic; otherwise the change is limited to the weekend rule and tests.

maintainability.why: Named helpers with a documented search window are easy to follow, but two entry points each branch on isDailyWeekendSkip and the non-daily move logic is still applied separately in each, so a future rule change touches both.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Both occurrence paths call the new shared helpers; getUpcomingDates' own getDateWithSkippedWeekend mapping is pre-existing rather than a new bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated part is an explicit branch on the shared predicate in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates, not reshaped copied logic.

one_place.where: The predicate isDailyWeekendSkip and getWeekdayOccurrences are shared, but the decision skip-vs-move is taken separately in getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts) and getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts), each with its own fallback to getDateWithSkippedWeekend.
